principles.immutableOrigin: Never rewrite the original wording or first-published date of a prediction to fit later evidence.
principles.publicationRule: A prediction is analysis, not fact. Public articles must label confirmed evidence, inference and FlyPig prediction separately.

predictions.title: An Android-like common layer will emerge for Physical AI
predictions.originalPrediction: As robot bodies, compute and low-level control become more modular, the industry will converge around one or more common software abstraction layers that let higher-level agents and applications operate across heterogeneous robot hardware.
falsifiers: Major robot vendors remain vertically closed with no meaningful cross-platform skill or runtime portability through 2030.
Robot applications continue to require predominantly body-specific software stacks with little reusable abstraction above ROS-class middleware.

latestAssessment.summary: Confidence rises from 0.77 to 0.79. Qualcomm's agreement to acquire PickNik is important because the target is the longtime steward of MoveIt, a widely adopted ROS-based manipulation framework, and Qualcomm explicitly says MoveIt should remain open-source, community-driven and supported across third-party hardware. This makes an open, hardware-agnostic robotics abstraction layer a strategic platform asset rather than only a developer convenience. The main falsifier remains live: the transaction has not yet closed, Qualcomm plans first-class optimization around its own Dragonwing platforms, and the industry still lacks an accepted cross-vendor application contract.

predictions.title: Reference robots will lower the cost of entering Physical AI
predictions.originalPrediction: Reference robot designs and increasingly productized robot bodies will reduce the need for application companies to design complete electromechanical systems from scratch, creating an ODM-like layer for Physical AI.
falsifiers: Reference designs fail to move beyond research demonstrations into repeatable developer or commercial platforms.
Mechanical, safety and task heterogeneity prevent meaningful reuse of robot bodies and subsystems.

latestAssessment.summary: Confidence slips from 0.84 to 0.83 while status remains strengthening. Figure's decision to decommission its F.02 fleet as F.03 grows is meaningful counter-evidence to a simple ODM-style commoditization story: the company cites custom actuators, proprietary hardware and the engineering cost of disassembly while already preparing F.04. The broader evidence base still supports increasingly productized robot bodies and subsystems, but rapid hardware-generation turnover, safety requirements and proprietary electromechanics can limit the durability and reuse economics of any one reference body.

predictions.title: Long-term differentiation will migrate above increasingly modular hardware
predictions.originalPrediction: Physical AI hardware can create large businesses, but as major hardware classes mature and become more comparable, a growing share of durable differentiation will move toward runtime platforms, reusable skills, applications, workflow integration and operating data.
falsifiers: Hardware vendors retain most industry margin and bargaining power despite broad component and platform standardization.
Reusable skills and application software fail to achieve meaningful portability or recurring economics across robot platforms.

latestAssessment.summary: Confidence rises from 0.77 to 0.81. Qualcomm is moving to acquire the steward of a widely used open manipulation framework, AMD is moving to acquire World Labs for spatial-intelligence and foundation-model expertise, and Agility is extending humanoid safety into an off-robot integration layer with FORT. Together these events show platform companies competing for middleware, models, world simulation, safety and deployment infrastructure above increasingly modular compute and robot hardware. Counter-evidence remains material: these moves may reinforce vertically integrated vendor power rather than create independent software economics, so FlyPig is not treating them as proof that hardware margins or bargaining power will decline.

predictions.title: Robot skills will become a reusable application primitive
predictions.originalPrediction: Bounded capabilities such as navigate, inspect, grasp, dock and deliver will increasingly be exposed as testable, permissioned skills that higher-level agents can compose into workflows without commanding joints directly.
falsifiers: End-to-end models make explicit reusable skill interfaces largely unnecessary.
Safety and embodiment differences prevent skills from becoming meaningfully reusable across platforms.

latestAssessment.summary: Confidence remains 0.53 and status remains weakening. Qualcomm's planned acquisition of PickNik is a useful counterweight because MoveIt exposes reusable planning, manipulation, perception and kinematics capabilities across heterogeneous hardware, reinforcing the value of stable composable interfaces. But MoveIt is middleware rather than evidence of a portable marketplace of packaged robot behaviors, so the event is scored neutral for FP-PAI-004. The working thesis remains hybrid: stable external capability contracts can persist even as increasingly general policies generate more behavior internally.
